title: The traveling kitchen in Calloway's band
summary: The band carried a stove, took turns cooking, and once cooking cabbage in a Youngstown theater made the audience drool.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now, since you're on the subject about us not being able to eat in restaurants, do you remember when we was with Calloway when you guys had the kitchen --
-- that we used to have on the road?
Yeah, we used to carry a kitchen.
And we used to take turns about cooking?

And do you remember when we played the theater in Youngstown and the food was going out in the audience and the man come back and told us not to cook no more because the people were sitting out there drooling?
I think Feet and Lamar Wright put some cabbage on and had it cooking while the show was on, --
-- and the aroma went all out in the theater.
And the manager came back and said, 'Hey, fellows, everybody in the audience is starving to death.
Please cool it over that cabbage back there."
We carried that stove around because it was necessary. We'd get into some towns where there was no restaurants --
-- and we just -- we had to go a long ways to get some food.
So we just had us an automatic kitchen and we set up business and everybody would take turns and go to the store on your day --
